name: Why choose an owner-operated remodeling contractor over an independent handyman?

mainEntity.name: Why choose an owner-operated remodeling contractor over an independent handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose an owner-operated general contractor when repairs cross multiple trades or require deep finish expertise. Many independent handymen specialize in narrow tasks or lack structural remodeling skills, meaning you must hire separate drywallers, painters, and tile setters. A hands-on contractor like Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling brings broad carpentry, drywall, and tile craftsmanship to basic repairs while retaining trade connections for plumbing and electrical needs. This ensures your repairs meet long-term remodeling standards rather than serving as temporary, cosmetic patches.
acceptedAnswer.description: An owner-operated contractor brings cross-trade skills in drywall, tile, and framing, delivering high-grade structural workmanship backed by BBB-accredited accountability.
